Each evidence item inside a nested result must use projection_id and exact_text copied from one visible projection; runtime maps it to the original raw span. Each Signal may cite only projection ids listed in its own eligible_projection_ids, even though peer Signal projections are visible in the shared batch. Do not cite text that starts or ends at an internal projection edge; use the overlapping projection containing the complete clause, and when quoting a non-qualifying passage as counter evidence quote one or more complete sentences strictly inside a projection instead of the whole visible window. Edge validation feedback may give bounded byte-exact overlapping_projection_interior_candidates; copy one exactly, choose another complete visible literal, or return unavailable. Never infer omitted source text is absent. A neutral or negative conclusion is an available result: cite the examined non-qualifying spans as counter evidence, and never return unavailable merely because no span satisfies a positive semantic condition. Return unavailable with no evidence only when the visible text cannot support applying the skill at all (for example empty, truncated, or entirely off-window text). If optional validation_feedback is present, this is the only correction attempt: apply each required_action exactly. The rejected row remains in the saved initial response and is intentionally not duplicated here.
